name: textarea
description: A source-owned shadcn-style multi-line text input for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: A styled native <textarea>, forwarding native attributes/events; the semantic-invalid presentation is driven by the `invalid` prop alongside native `aria-invalid`.
documentation.usage: Textarea { placeholder: "Message", rows: 4, oninput: move |event| value.set(event.value()) }
documentation.accessibility: A native `<textarea>` with `aria-invalid` reflecting the `invalid` prop (`registry/ui/textarea.rs`); accessible naming is the caller's responsibility via an associated `Label` or `aria-label`.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling beyond native multi-line text-input behavior.
